name: Fieldwork
description:
You are a research scholar in the employ of the University, delivering treatises based on your adventures in exchange for grants.

At the start of each Quest, privately choose a research subject with the GM that is relevant to the upcoming adventure.

During the next Intermezzo, you must write an actual report on that subject and privately grade it from 1 to 10. Read the report word-for-word to the other players (who represent the University Board) without commenting or participating in their subsequent discussion. Each board member privately grades the report from 1 to 10, then reveal all grades (including yours) and average them; you receive this average amount as Treasure in the form of a University grant.

Describe how you attempt to win academic favor.
